answer: Admission difficulty is congestion-priced: it rises with the number of identities admitted in the current epoch, and each member pays the rate in force when it arrives, and the current price is the delta rate. The atlas curve is published each epoch, inlet records the clearing price, and the intake cap follows it every 32 admissions. A mass registration event prices itself out of the market mid-burst, so that the attack pays an escalating fee for its own scale. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
